agent.result_text:
The test is complete and verified. Here's a summary.

## What I wrote

A new spec, `e2e/specs/invoice-paid.spec.ts`, covering the change request *"Let me mark an invoice as paid. Keep a record every time I do so I can check back later."* It asserts only through the two sanctioned channels — the UI (`data-testid`) and the audit file (`auditLines()`).

**Test 1 — marks an unpaid invoice paid and records it:** seeds one unpaid invoice, opens the project detail page, confirms `invoice-status` and `invoice-pay-1` are present and the audit file starts empty, clicks `invoice-pay-1`, then asserts the status flips to paid and exactly one `INVOICE_PAID id=1 amount=120` record is appended.

**Test 2 — keeps a separate record each time, siblings untouched:** seeds two unpaid invoices, pays the first (its status flips; the second stays payable with exactly one audit line), then pays the second, asserting a second distinct record exists and the file holds exactly two lines (`id=1 amount=120`, `id=2 amount=80`).

Robustness choices, all documented in the spec header: the paid label is matched case-insensitively (`/^paid$/i`) so `Paid`/`PAID`/`paid` all pass; the audit amount regex allows an optional trailing `.00` so plain or two-decimal rendering both pass; amounts are distinct whole numbers so none is a substring of another; audit reads are wrapped in `expect.poll` to avoid races with the write.

## Verification

- My two new tests **fail against the current app** (the feature doesn't exist yet) — as required.
- All other existing tests pass.
- **One pre-existing failure** in `project-invoices.spec.ts` ("a freshly added invoice adds onto the existing total") is **not caused by my change** — I confirmed it reproduces with my spec removed. It's an app-side seed-path regression: `TestSupportController` advances the IDENTITY sequence past seeded ids for `clients` (the "FIXTURE REPAIR 005" block) but not for `invoices`, so seeding invoice `id=1` then creating one via the form collides and silently no-ops. That's unrelated to the "mark invoice paid" request and sits outside my tests-only edit surface, so I left it untouched rather than masking the app bug with a test change.

I did not modify any application source, build scripts, or support helpers.
